name: gap_fill_fade_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY or BANKNIFTY gaps 0.3-1.5% at open due to overnight global cues (SGX Nifty, Dow futures, Nasdaq), institutional desks with VWAP and arrival-price benchmarks immediately see sub-benchmark fills and begin accumulating (for gap-down) or distributing (for gap-up) against the gap direction. Within the first 25 minutes, this institutional flow is systematic and large enough to create measurable reversal momentum at the 5-second level. We detect the first 5-second reversal bar as confirmation that gap-fill flow has begun, then ride the initial 20-40 spot point impulse of this institutional rebalancing. Index gaps are smoother than single-stock gaps because no earnings or company events drive them — pure overnight noise from correlated global cues.
core_signal_oneliner: Gap 0.3-1.5% day: first 5s bar closing against the gap direction with RSI showing momentum exhaustion, within the first 25 minutes of NIFTY/BANKNIFTY session
